headline: Learning experience design leader
summary: I design scenario-based learning so customer and partner teams can apply knowledge in the flow of work. At Okta I lead learning experience and digital design — content standards, AI-assisted authoring with clear review, and the courses and simulations I still build myself. Fifteen years in customer education; promoted twice in under three years and a CEdMA Pinnacle Award for Innovation.
bioParagraphs: I'm a learning experience designer and content strategist. I build self-paced courses, simulations, and scenario-based practice so customer, partner, and frontline teams can learn and apply what they need in the flow of work.
At Okta I lead learning experience and digital design. I was promoted twice in under three years, and that work earned a CEdMA Pinnacle Award for Innovation.
I set content standards and guide how teams use AI-assisted authoring — with clear review baked in. I also stay hands-on. I still build the courses and practice experiences myself.
